assumptions.statement: Block-level structure of HD00–1601 et al. is now known from the 2026-08-11 approval news (extents, 1668.2 ha, one belt / one axis / two centers / multiple nodes). Parcel redlines, FAR, height, density, setbacks, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection lines, and engineering constraints remain unpublished. geometry/constraints.geojson stays empty and records this remaining gap.
assumptions.impact: Openline spatial moves remain conceptual. Structure overlay is written into the proposal; no FAR/height/density/redline conclusions are claimed as approved parcel controls. Zhongzhiyuan remains a required competition key area; it is not covered by this block plan's published extents.

assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001/002/003 are provisional footprints derived from announcement text bounds and area fitting (DATA-SRC-PROVISIONAL-BOUNDARIES-20260605), not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: Areas and key-area detailed design are discussion-grade. When official polygons arrive, regenerate geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and drawings as a whole package.

assumptions.statement: Openline spine (L1 Fact Line + L2 Spine), three area missions (full-stack innovation / open questions / urban adoption), Kilometer Zero / The Join / The Strata Wall (three landmarks), four spatial rules (Join·Verify·Exit·Inherit), two wings (Zhongguancun tech-service / Xiaoyuehe scene-empowerment), five material rail translations, Wudaokou stitch deck (OL-07 three-level pier deck), the Dazhongsi Native Street (OL-10) plus station integration and four-quadrant arrival (OL-04), and the Zhongzhiyuan Upgradeable Urban Motherboard—shared base, five upgradeable unit types, Full-Stack Collaboration Street, and Global AI Standards and Governance Center (OL-02)—are conceptual urban-design suggestions for professional deepening, not approved government programs, control plans, or construction commitments. Stitch-deck span/load/construction organization, 1733 24h RoW, Native Street ground-floor agreements, North 3rd Ring crossings, Qinghe blue-line setbacks, Xuebei ground-floor agreements, shared-platform utility capacity, and controlled embodied-AI scenarios require later confirmation after redlines, surveys, and owner/metro/street agreement.
assumptions.impact: Narrative, figures, and scenario cards must keep provisional labeling; operations and events are invitations to participate, not claimed endorsements. Signature diagrams are discussion-grade imagery, not statutory drawings. Do not treat Dazhongsi station or a geometric figure as the east wing or as the 72 ha district product.

assumptions.statement: The 2026-08-11 approved block plan (HD00–1601 et al., 2024–2035) covers east Xinjiekouwai Dajie, west Zhongguancun Street, north Chengfu Road, south Xizhimenwai Dajie, 9 blocks, ≈1668.2 ha. This is wider east–west and shorter north–south than the competition overall ≈11.4 km². Dazhongsi and Wudaokou are the two statutory centers; Zhichun Road and Sidao-kou are named nodes. Zhongzhiyuan is inside the competition overall (north to North 5th Ring) and is a required key area (192.1 ha; 5th Ring / Qinghe tasks); its public anchor is Xuebei / Dongsheng, ~2.5–3 km north of Chengfu, so it is not inside this block plan's published extents. 1,668.2 ha must never be used as the denominator for the submitted 1,141 ha metrics.
assumptions.impact: West wing is hung on Zhongguancun Street as the approved axis. Origin and Dazhongsi map to the two centers. Zhongzhiyuan stays a required competition key area and is not written as this plan's third center. Geometry is not rebuilt until official polygons arrive. Draft-stage 2035 facility counts (298/37/62/36) stay background_only.

assumptions.statement: A 24-hour public right-of-way through 1733 B1–B2 along the existing Line 12 Exit D → Line 13 Exits A/B outdoor transfer, plus four-quadrant walking at North 3rd Ring West Rd × Jingbao rail bridge (OL-04 arrival system). The Dazhongsi district product is The Native Street (OL-10): a ground-floor protocol along HQ edges, 1733 frontage, and park edge so verified capability can be tried, bought, subscribed, or refused on the street. Public assembly uses that street and existing 1733 bookable rooms; movable seats are furniture, not a third landmark and not a circle cut. This is a design recommendation. It requires agreement among the 1733 owner, metro operator, street authority, and ground-floor owners. It is not a taking, not a replica Yongle Bell, not a bell-shaped roof, not claimed as approved, and does not substitute for the published ~2027 in-station transfer. After that date the street rule remains. Lightweight inserts only on 1733 roof; no large trees on structure.
assumptions.impact: OL-04 near-term moves (rain cover, lighting, accessibility, wayfinding, bike parking) can proceed as street/public-realm work; the RoW, ramp/lift, and Native Street ground-floor pilots stay labeled pending agreement. ByteDance/Douyin is not written as a committed delivery partner. Park Phase II south (restored rails, 3rd-Ring balcony, gantry) is treated as built and is not redrawn. Landmarks are now three (Kilometer Zero / The Join / The Strata Wall), added per agent.4 review; movable seats remain furniture, not a landmark and not the architecture of a bronze circle.

assumptions.statement: The Zhongzhiyuan Upgradeable Urban Motherboard—one shared base, five upgradeable innovation-unit types, one Full-Stack Collaboration Street, and one Global AI Standards and Governance Center—is a conceptual urban-design suggestion. Park Phase II north (Jing-Zhang Ring, three slow routes, fishbone paths, and Jianting undercroft) is treated as built and is not redrawn. Existing buildings, courtyards, utilities, blue/flood lines, tenure, road redlines, and structural capacity remain to be surveyed. Xuebei shared ground floors, public technology platforms, controlled embodied-AI spaces, and any new structures require owner, infrastructure, flood, fire, data-security, and safety approvals. They are not a taking and are not claimed as approved; public-road testing is outside this scheme's authority.
assumptions.impact: OL-02 begins with building/interface surveys, links to the built fishbone paths, and lightweight shared-lobby, developer-workshop, and standards-topic pilots. Upgradeable R&D units, shared technology platforms, and the governance center remain pending official boundaries, capacity checks, and operating agreements. National AI-platform delivery, a confirmed operator, or Xuebei-owner consent is not claimed. Card 03 is the governance center's public deliberation and Human Review interface, not Zhongzhiyuan's sole purpose.

assumptions.statement: Phasing capital logic uses order-of-magnitude estimates from Beijing comparable-project unit-cost bands (reversible steel-timber deck 15k-25k CNY/sqm; street-section retrofit 30M-50M CNY/km; TOD land premium 10-20% within 800m of stations). These are NOT estimates of record: no survey, no redline, no parcel ownership data yet.
assumptions.impact: phasing-capital figure and any capital narrative are discussion-grade magnitude logic ('who pays / who operates / how revenue returns to public maintenance'), not a cost plan. Recalculate when official geometry and parcel data arrive.

assumptions.statement: Heritage grading (A: 1909 original fabric, read-only in place / B: later altered segments, touchable and sittable / C: lost segments, free for new work) is a METHOD derived from literature comparison against the documented 1909 alignment (Qinghuayuan station house 1910 as the documented anchor). It is NOT an archaeological survey result. Oral-history content is a collection plan (30 interviewees: crossing keepers, line-side residents, station staff) with empty slots; no quotes are fabricated.
assumptions.impact: heritage-soul figure presents grading bands and voice slots as a framework to be verified by archaeological survey and real interviews. No segment is claimed as verified 1909 original except documented protected anchors.

assumptions.statement: Ecological commitments (runoff volume capture 75/80/85% by phase; corridor summer surface temperature -0.5/-1.2/-2.0 C vs surroundings; embodied-carbon cap with >=60% reclaimed materials and operational carbon intensity -25/-40% vs 2025 baseline; biodiversity net gain baseline/+5%/+10% with >=70% native species; canopy cover 25/30/35%) are design TARGETS set against Beijing sponge-city practice bands and international BNG practice. They are commitments to be monitored, not measured results.
assumptions.impact: eco-commitments figure presents targets with monitoring loop (sensors on L1, data into the civic trust, published via the Verify gate). Recalculate against official sheets when they arrive; do not quote as achieved performance.
